article_title: Qantas flight grounded after bedbug outbreak

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Qantas introduced a new direct route between Rome and Perth.
A Qantas flight was cancelled so a plane could be deeply cleaned after bedbugs were found around some seats.
Australian authorities banned all long-distance flights.
Passengers refused to board because the flight was too long.
tasks.correct_answer: A Qantas flight was cancelled so a plane could be deeply cleaned after bedbugs were found around some seats.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בביטול טיסת Qantas כדי לבצע ניקוי יסודי לאחר שהתגלו פשפשי מיטה במספר קטן של מושבים.

tasks.prompt: What happened on the previous Perth-to-Rome flight?
options: Passengers complained that bugs were biting them during the nearly 17-hour journey.
The aircraft landed early because its engines failed.
All passengers were moved to first class.
The airline completed a deep clean before take-off.
tasks.correct_answer: Passengers complained that bugs were biting them during the nearly 17-hour journey.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בטיסה הקודמת, שנמשכה כמעט 17 שעות, נוסעים דיווחו שנעקצו בידי חרקים.

tasks.prompt: What does “grounded” mean in this report?
options: The plane was flown without passengers.
The aircraft was kept from flying while the problem was handled.
The passengers slept on the airport floor.
The airline reduced the ticket price.
tasks.correct_answer: The aircraft was kept from flying while the problem was handled.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: grounded פירושו שהמטוס הושבת ולא הורשה לטוס בזמן שבוצע בו ניקוי יסודי.

tasks.prompt: How did Qantas assist customers affected by the cancellation?
options: It gave every customer free antihistamines for a year.
It returned the aircraft to service immediately.
It asked customers to arrange their own travel.
It provided accommodation and rebooked them within 48 hours of the original departure.
tasks.correct_answer: It provided accommodation and rebooked them within 48 hours of the original departure.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Qantas מסרה שסיפקה לנוסעים שנפגעו מקום לינה והזמינה להם טיסות חלופיות בתוך 48 שעות ממועד ההמראה המקורי.

tasks.prompt: Why did the airline cancel the Rome-to-Perth service instead of using the plane immediately?
options: The route had become legally unavailable.
The aircraft needed time for engineers and maintenance teams to perform a deep clean.
The passengers asked for a shorter journey.
The airline had run out of fuel in Rome.
tasks.correct_answer: The aircraft needed time for engineers and maintenance teams to perform a deep clean.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטול אפשר לצוותי ההנדסה והתחזוקה לבצע ניקוי יסודי לאחר זיהוי הבעיה במושבים.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “alternative flights” mean?
options: Flights with no assigned destination
Private flights operated only by passengers
Different flights arranged to replace the cancelled service
Flights that use trains for part of the journey
tasks.correct_answer: Different flights arranged to replace the cancelled service
tasks.explanation_hebrew: alternative flights הן טיסות אחרות שהוזמנו במקום השירות שבוטל.

tasks.prompt: What does the article say about bedbugs and their bites?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שפשפשי מיטה הם טפילים קטנים חסרי כנפיים, שהם חיים על בגדים, רהיטים ומצעים, ושעקיצותיהם מגרדות אך בדרך כלל אינן גורמות לבעיה רפואית חמורה.
expected_points: They can live on clothes, furniture and bedding.
The bites do not usually cause serious health problems.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the incident and Qantas's response.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול תלונות על עקיצות בטיסה הקודמת, זיהוי הבעיה במושבי תיירים, השבתת המטוס לניקוי והסיוע לנוסעים שנפגעו.
expected_points: Passengers on the Perth-to-Rome flight reported being bitten by bugs.
The airline said an issue was identified on a small number of economy seats.
The Boeing 787 was grounded for a deep clean, causing the return service to be cancelled.
Qantas apologised, provided accommodation and arranged replacement flights within 48 hours.

tasks.prompt: Why can a small bedbug problem still cause major travel disruption?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שפשפשים קשים ויקרים להדברה, עלולים להתפשט דרך בגדים וריהוט ודורשים טיפול יסודי, ולכן אפילו כמה מושבים יכולים להשבית כלי תחבורה.
expected_points: Bedbugs can live in fabric, furniture, clothing and bedding.
They can be difficult and expensive to eliminate.
A thorough treatment may require time and access to the whole affected area.
Grounding an aircraft for cleaning can cancel a long-haul service and require many passengers to be rebooked.

tasks.prompt: Write a short neutral notice to affected passengers using only facts from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול התנצלות, סיבת הביטול בניסוח עובדתי, הניקוי היסודי, הלינה וההזמנה מחדש בתוך 48 שעות, ללא הגזמה.
expected_points: Apologise for the cancellation of the Rome-to-Perth service.
Explain that a bedbug issue was identified on a small number of economy seats.
State that the aircraft is undergoing a deep clean.
Confirm that accommodation and alternative flights within 48 hours are being provided.
